reasoning_content:
The frontend was terminated because examination failed during restart attempt. Now examination restarted. Let me restart frontend again and wait for all deps.

But first, the frontend process needs `pnpm` available. process-compose inherits its environment from when it was started. The PATH when I started process-compose was `$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH`. `pnpm` is in /usr/local/bin. Good.

Let me restart frontend and wait.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/node24/bin:$PATH" && process-compose process restart frontend >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "frontend restarted"; sleep 75; process-compose process logs frontend 2>/dev/null | grep -v '"level"' | tail -20; echo "=== port 3002 ==="; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3002/app/ 2>&1

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && export PATH=\"$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/node24/bin:$PATH\" && process-compose process restart frontend >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"frontend restarted\"; sleep 75; process-compose process logs frontend 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\"level\"' | tail -20; echo \"=== port 3002 ===\"; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" http://localhost:3002/app/ 2>&1", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Restart frontend and verify"}
